title: SonicWall Warns of Actively Exploited SSL-VPN Vulnerability That Bypasses SAML and MFA Protection
content_md: SonicWall has urged customers to address an SSL-VPN authentication vulnerability that can bypass SAML controls, including associated multifactor authentication measures. This issue is tracked as CVE-2026-19868 and affects SonicOS deployments that utilize SAML for SSL-VPN logins. The company has investigated reports suggesting potential exploitation but has not confirmed a widespread attack campaign in its advisory.
